method: Wash and dry the salad leaves and tomato; shred the leaves and slice the tomato thinly. Reserve most of the leaves and any excess tomato for a side salad so the wholemeal wrap can close.
Choose firm tofu labelled ready to eat. Drain and pat it dry, then cut it into thin slices; keep it chilled until assembly.
Use the measured 0% Greek yoghurt dressing as a ready-to-eat sauce or dressing. Keep chilled sauces refrigerated until assembly.
Use a ready-to-eat wholemeal wrap and lay it flat on a clean plate.

Combine the prepared filling with the measured 0% Greek yoghurt dressing. Add a small handful of the prepared leaves and some sliced tomato. Put a manageable layer of filling down the centre, fold in the sides and roll up firmly. Serve all remaining filling and vegetables alongside as the side salad.
Eat now, or put the meal and any side salad into a covered container and refrigerate promptly. Eat within 24 hours and follow any shorter ingredient use-by date; keep it chilled until eating.

review.notes: Plain wholemeal rolled wrap contains thin pale ready-to-eat firm tofu slices combined with Greek yoghurt dressing, fresh salad leaves/tomato, and reserved leaves/tomato side salad alongside. No seared tofu, cheese or herbs; exact title/method checked.
